nom: SKIN1004 Lab in Nature Niacinamide 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mild transient redness right after application in one case, but otherwise no reactions, no breakouts, and no fragrance irritation.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports no greasy feel and no over-drying.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced sebum, better oil control, and no added greasiness or breakouts.
segments.mature: A 40-year-old reviewer who normally reacts with excess oil reports plumper, softer skin without the usual oiliness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report skin looking firmer, plumper, and more youthful, with one 40-year-old noting plumper skin and reduced sunken appearance.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report increased hydration, smoother and plumper skin, and one on tretinoin found it counteracted the drying effect; no reports of dryness from the product itself.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly decreased redness with continued use; one sensitive-skin reviewer noted brief redness immediately after application that faded over time.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle and non-irritating even at 10% niacinamide, with one noting a slight tingly sensation described as gentle exfoliation rather than irritation.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report lightening or fading of dark spots and more even skin tone over a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts or pimples, including those who normally react to new products; one reviewer mentions reduced bumps and acne marks, with no dissenting reports of breakouts found in this set.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily or combination skin report reduced sebum and oil control without a mattified or dry after-feel.

aspects.libelle: Small bottle size relative to price
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: I've been using niacinamide 10 boosting shot ampoule for about a month. My skin is noticeably brighter and has a consistent tone. I've been getting a lot of comments about that too! It's been the perfect product as I've been prepping for my wedding and just trying to improve my skin overall. I have sensitive skin so it did make my skin a bit red (just after application, the redness did not last) in the beginning, but that has lessened over time. I'd recommend using it 2-3x a week to start. I really love this product and I will be continuing to use it in my skin care routine!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review and I LOVED trialing this serum. I am a serum and skincare enthusiast, typically using high end brands with scientific backing. This product didn't disappoint. You use a small amount, and I could easily see decreased redness, oiliness and pore size within two days of use. After 2 weeks my skin was so refreshed and beautiful without makeup. I will be buying in future as a regular part of my regimen. No adverse effects were noted whereas with some brands I can tend to break out. So that was a win that it was a clean, gentle, effective product.

I received this product in exchange for my review. I used this in both my AM and PM skin routine. It's very hydrating which is crucial for me since I'm on tretinoin. This pairs along wonderfully with it and moisturizes my skin which tends to dry up when I put on the tretinoin. I highly recommend this product as it provides deep hydration for the skin, it feels nice and silky on my skin, and it's a good sized bottle. It should last about a month.

I was sent this Lab in Nature Niacinamide 10 Boosting Shot Ampoule to test. I love Niacidamide for helping reduce my pores and combat my oily skin. I have sensitive skin so I have to watch everything I test. So far, no increased breakouts which is a huge plus! I cleanse my face, then use a toning pad. I use a drop of the niacinamide before putting on my moisturizer. Definitely going to continue using in my nighttime routine.

My skin loved this ampoule! My face felt smooth and looked so hydrated. I have sensitive skin on my face and had no bad reaction or any pimples! I have combination skin and no greasy feel or over drying. I definitely would purchase this ampoule! I received many compliments on my complexion too! I made sure to press it into my face instead of massaging it in. Makes a huge difference. This ampoule is in my top 10 for sure.

extraits.titre: Makes my face soft and plump
extraits.texte: I'm 40 years old and I usually have problems with face serums creams etc. Normally I get super oily no matter what I use. Not this stuff. It also seemingly overnight made my face appear plump(not the sunken in tired eyes I'm getting so used to nowadays haha). I've noticed it makes my skin super soft too,like baby soft. Definitely love and recommend!

extraits.titre: It's okay, but I'm not blown away
extraits.texte: I've only used this a few times so far, so I haven't noticed a huge difference yet. It feels nice going on and is easy to add to my skincare routine, but I'd probably need to use it longer to know if it really makes a difference for my skin.
